verdict.rationale: Issuing API credentials is a fair question for a SaaS CRM with a public REST API, so the axis applies. The pack mentions an OAuth flow for apps (attio-docs-7), an app-level ATTIO_API_TOKEN (attio-docs-97) and pricing-tier 'Permission controls' (attio-docs-70). None of these documents scoped, least-privilege API keys or tokens that could be issued to an agent. User permission controls and a bare OAuth mention are adjacent features, not evidence of credential scoping.
